f.title: Definition: health data are sensitive personal data
f.statement: Binding definition that triggers the stricter rules for sensitive data (Art. 8, Art. 12): sensitive personal data are personal data affecting the most intimate sphere of the data subject, or whose misuse may lead to discrimination or entail a serious risk to the data subject. By way of illustration and not limitation, data that may reveal racial or ethnic origin, present or future health status, genetic information, religious, philosophical and moral beliefs, political opinions and sexual preference are considered sensitive.

Binds private-sector controllers (responsables), including MAHs and sponsors processing adverse-event and other health data (health status is sensitive personal data, Art. 2(VI)). Under Art. 2(VIII) 'días' in this Law means business days (días hábiles). The text states no difference between domestic and foreign cases.

f.title: Obtain consent for processing unless a legal exception applies; tacit consent valid by default
f.statement: All processing of personal data is subject to the data subject's consent, except as provided by this Law. Consent may be express (verbal, written, electronic, optical, unequivocal signs or other technology) or tacit (the privacy notice was made available and the data subject did not object). Tacit consent is valid as a general rule unless applicable legal provisions require express consent. Financial or asset data require express consent, save for the exceptions in Articles 9 and 36.

f.exceptions: Exceptions in this Law (Art. 9 for processing, Art. 36 for transfers). Sensitive data need express written consent (Art. 8).

Artículo 7. Todo tratamiento de datos personales estará sujeto al consentimiento de la persona titular,
salvo las excepciones previstas por la presente Ley.
El consentimiento podrá manifestarse de forma expresa o tácita. Se deberá entender que el
consentimiento es expreso cuando la voluntad de la persona titular se manifieste verbalmente, por
escrito, por medios electrónicos, ópticos, signos inequívocos o por cualquier otra tecnología.
El consentimiento será tácito cuando habiéndose puesto a disposición de la persona titular el aviso de
privacidad, esta no manifieste su voluntad en sentido contrario.
Por regla general será válido el consentimiento tácito, salvo que las disposiciones jurídicas aplicables
exijan que la voluntad de la persona titular se manifieste expresamente.
Los datos financieros o patrimoniales requerirán el consentimiento expreso de la persona titular, salvo
las excepciones a que se refieren los artículos 9 y 36 de la presente Ley.

rows.quote_en:
Article 7. All processing of personal data shall be subject to the consent of the data subject, save for the exceptions provided by this Law.
Consent may be expressed expressly or tacitly. Consent shall be understood to be express when the will of the data subject is expressed verbally, in writing, by electronic or optical means, by unequivocal signs or by any other technology.
Consent shall be tacit when, the privacy notice having been made available to the data subject, the data subject does not express a will to the contrary.
As a general rule tacit consent shall be valid, unless the applicable legal provisions require the will of the data subject to be expressed expressly.
Financial or asset data shall require the express consent of the data subject, save for the exceptions referred to in Articles 9 and 36 of this Law.

Article 37.
